With gross load already at **84.1 GW** on 07-24 and heat intensifying across all major load centers, the grid is entering a **sustained peak demand corridor** that should rebuild the spike node count and RT price volatility that collapsed yesterday. Solar at 30.4 GW will continue to suppress mid-day RT prices (HE11-15) while accelerating the evening ramp (HE17-21) — the YELWJCKT constraint cluster binding in HE19-20 yesterday is a structural preview of what to expect through the week. **The week of 07-27 to 07-29 represents the highest load risk window** — HEN should pre-position DA commitments at strong-Sharpe nodes and maintain RT optionality at MV_VALV4_RN, HOLCOMB_RN1, and FALFUR_RN to capture anticipated RT spike premiums during HE18-21.
